{{YFHR|77}} ==Events== * The [[Hall of Speakers]] begins a program of compassion. Funded by a modest merchant and landowner tax, food was sent into the [[Hive Ward]] to help the starving. Protests amongst the [[Fated]] and [[Fraternity of Order]] started within a month. The program shuts down after only three months in operation.{{b|Planescape|In the Cage: A Guide to Sigil|pdf=17274|page=106}} * [[Barl Hoxun]] discovers five portal arches under a pile of rubble, and builds the [[Bottle & Jug]] around them. The B&J becomes one of the most notorious pubs in Sigil, mostly due to its gambling and its boxing arena.{{b|Planescape|In the Cage: A Guide to Sigil|pdf=17274|page=109}} * Hellcats and hordlings attack the obscure [[Prime Material plane|Prime]] world of [[Glemayne]], destroying [[Ombidias]]' tribe.{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=23}} * [[Omar]] becomes [[factol]] of the [[Harmonium]]... and immediately tries to disband the [[faction]] and shut down the [[City Barracks]]. Omar is revealed to be an [[Revolutionary League|Anarchist]]. The Harmonium later insists they simply let him think he was in charge so he'd reveal himself. The [[Mercykillers]] execute him after a brief trial, and he becomes a hero and martyr for the Anarchists.{{b|Planescape|The Factol's Manifesto|pdf=17275|page=114}} * Prince [[Azlan]] takes up leadership of the [[Guardians]], a [[sect]] based out of [[Elysium]].{{b|Planescape|Planes of Conflict|pdf=17278|page=22, A Player's Guide to Conflict}} ==References== {| class="fandom-table browser" style="width:100%" | class="prev"|'''Previous Year'''
